_: PLACEHOLDERS. Every number below marked `placeholder: true` is a guess, chosen only to be dimensionally sane so the program compiles and the tests have something to run against. T15 replaces them with values produced by the T14 economic simulation, swept against real M2SL history. Do not tune these by hand on the way past — a plausible-looking hand-picked number is worse than an obvious placeholder, because it looks decided.

peg._: supply = k x m2_value. M2SL is billions of USD at 6dp (22176.1 -> 22176100000), so k = 1e6 gives 1 ENC per $1,000 of M2: ~22.18bn ENC at today's M2, ~2.2e16 base units against a u64 ceiling of 1.8e19. Six decimals rather than nine because nine overflows u64 at this supply. NOT a placeholder: fixed by the arithmetic, and asserted in math.rs.

vault._: The vault's floor as a share of total supply. Below it the faucet pays nothing at all - no share, no welcome grant. It governs the faucet, never the burn: burning lowers the vault's own share, so a floor enforced by refusing to burn would break the peg.

tenancy._: How long one tenancy lasts before anyone may settle it: 30 days, deliberately equal to prices.interpolationSeconds so an auction settles against a price that has finished travelling rather than one still in motion. There is no holding cost - the term IS the mechanism by which assets change hands (Ruling A, 2026-08-12).

faucet._: pot(N) = alpha x max(0, vault - floor x supply), snapshotted when epoch N opens. Register in N, collect your share of pot(N) in N+1 - dividing a current pot by a previous headcount would let a farm drain many times the pot. welcomeGrant is 1,000 ENC at 6dp, one per wallet ever, capped at grantsPerEpoch per epoch AND refused below the floor.

sanity._: Bounds on what this program will believe from the oracle. A real monthly M2 move is a fraction of a percent, so 10% is already generous; a larger jump means the feed is wrong, not that the economy changed. maxSingleMint (1e15 base units, ~4.5% of today's supply) caps the damage if a bad quote passes the change check.

prices._: How long an asset price takes to travel to its rescaled target after a supply change: 30 days. Interpolating rather than jumping is what makes prices tick every slot instead of once a month. NOT a placeholder - it mirrors PRICE_INTERPOLATION_SECONDS in state.rs and the two must agree.

assets._: The ten parody assets. Their names, image URIs and genesis prices land at T8 (init_asset); only the count is fixed here, because sync_m2 refuses to run until all ten exist.
